title: If i could, I’d give this  3.5 stars and read why!!
text:
If i could, I’d give this 3.5 stars and read why!!. To begin I’d like to get this 3.5 stars but, being that is not possible, I’ll include in a review as to why-

First of all, this arrives in a fabric carry tote bag that ties at the top.. this was quite unique and nice making things easy to travel/store. However, this would have been better if the tote bag zipped shut to secure it keeps clean while not in use. Although, most comforters arrive in plain plastic packaging- they offer a zipper to securely close that’s most beneficial! I wish the tote had a zipper...

It’s hard to hold anything against this comforter for being Light weight/thin/flat/crisp… If reading the description provided by the seller, they use light weight and crisp in their actual verbiage! So, being thin, shouldn’t/isn’t an issue- However, flat and lifeless is the best visual I could provide. Quilts by nature are not overly thick but, they do have some sense of some body to them.. I felt this lacked in that capacity- and when thinking of bedding.. that is something most expect and appreciate- A creature comfort feeling, something of substance that offers a warm an inviting feeling.. therefore, I deducted one star.

As for the color- we chose white. But, this feels to almost have a bit of a gray hue to the white, giving off the feeling of being old but, not in an heirloom quilt sort of way! It seems in trying to create a shabby chic/rustic look, the use of beige string trim was done. This doesn’t resemble as much shabby chic.. Only, more of a dinghy look. I realize, this may just be a with the white color.. But, when providing bedding in any space- be it a guestroom or otherwise, as the buyer I want to insure the confidence of nice/clean and inviting space to sleep- even though this may be all of the above… It’s important that the item look the part as well!! Therefore, if I could- I’d deduct .5 stars- simply because as mentioned- this may only be a problem or, feeling with the white color?!

Overall, I did appreciate the random lines and stitching- that does hit on the “shabby chic” look quite well. I would definitely recommend being certain of color choice when ordering and if one is wanting this to appear with a brand new “wow factor-“ it may not be suited for you, at least in certain colors. If, wanting to create a nostalgic or, a more heirloom type setting ie, in a cabin or antique room setting.. then, this may fit what you’re looking for!
I do hope the info. provided was helpful.. feel free to say so!
